TCX.official on Instagram: "Carrie Anne Fleming, the beloved ‘Supernatural’ actress who portrayed Bobby Singer’s wife Karen across multiple seasons, has tragically passed away at 51 after a private battle with breast cancer. The Canadian star, born August 16, 1974, in Nova Scotia, succumbed to complications from the disease on February 26, 2026, in Sidney, British Columbia, as confirmed by her co-star Jim Beaver in a heartfelt Variety statement and social media tribute, where he mourned her as “my light, beautiful costar.” Known also for her recurring role as Candy Baker in ‘iZombie’ and early appearances in ‘Masters of Horror’ and an uncredited ‘Happy Gilmore’ scene, Fleming leaves behind her daughter Madalyn Rose, with fans flooding X and Facebook with condolences lamenting 2026’s string of losses.
